subject: mathematics
concept: Finding unknown angles in quadrilaterals (angles sum to 360 degrees)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tears the corners off a virtual paper quadrilateral and arranges them at a point to see they total 360 degrees
exercise.pictorial: Student labels the missing angle on a pictured quadrilateral diagram
exercise.abstract: Student calculates an unknown angle in a quadrilateral given the other three angles

misconception_flags: uses the triangle angle sum (180) instead of the quadrilateral sum (360)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
